name: build-dev
description: On merge to dev: compute the next semantic version, build the project image with the devops-authored Dockerfile, and push it to the sandbox-reachable dev registry (registry-mirror) tagged <version>a (alpha).

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: git-factory repo name; also the local image repository name

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: branch to build (the merge target, e.g. dev); defaults to dev

with.run:
set -e
export HOME=/tmp GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace
cd /workspace
BR="${inputs.ref}"; [ -n "$BR" ] || BR=dev
git checkout -q "$BR" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "cloned branch=$BR"
git log --oneline -1

set -eu
export HOME=/tmp
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
cd /workspace
git fetch -q --tags "$GIT_URL" || true
LATEST=$(git tag -l 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' | sed -E 's/^(v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -V | tail -1)
[ -n "$LATEST" ] || LATEST=v0.0.0
M=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$/\1/')
N=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$/\2/')
P=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$/\3/')
P=$((P+1))
VERSION="v${M}.${N}.${P}"
TAG="${VERSION}a"
echo "latest=$LATEST  next=$VERSION  image-tag=$TAG"
git tag -f "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
git push -q "$GIT_URL" "refs/tags/$TAG" 2>/dev/null && echo "pushed git tag $TAG" || echo "warn: git tag push skipped (non-fatal)"

set +e
export HOME=/tmp
TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#')
GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002
C=http://codearmory-containers:8089
NS='${inputs.namespace}'; REPO='${inputs.repo}'
# git-factory is the source of truth for repo->project; mirror that link into the
# container registry so the pushed image is project-scoped automatically.
PROJ=$(curl -s --max-time 20 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | grep "\"namespace\":\"$NS\"" | sed -E 's/.*"project":"([^"]*)".*/\1/' | head -1)
if [ -z "$PROJ" ]; then echo "link: no project mapped for $NS/$REPO - skipping"; exit 0; fi
CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/lk -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 20 -X PUT "$C/repositories/$NS/$REPO/project" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"project\":\"$PROJ\"}")
echo "link $NS/$REPO -> project $PROJ : HTTP $CODE"
[ -f /tmp/lk ] && cat /tmp/lk
exit 0
